experiment: Rust parallel frontend on the complete CI CLI graph
controls: Identical clean Git commit and source tree, compiler, build profile, Cargo job count, linker, CPU quota and memory ceiling.
Distinct initially absent Cargo targets and independent cache stores; both reports measured 1384 misses and zero hits.
Explicit checkout-scoped Kache sessions with inferred=false, positive measured request counts, and no cache errors or storage failures.
Both actual CLI binaries executed fn main(harness: Harness) { harness.stdio.println(40 + 2) } and printed exactly 42.
decision: Do not enable -Zthreads=4 in CI. This first controlled cold-build comparison regressed wall time by 20.88 percent and VM compiler time by 9.12 percent.
limitations: One trial per arm on a shared owned host; background host load was not held constant.
This measures an eight-CPU cold CLI build, not the hosted merge-queue p90 or warm incremental edits.
A startup execution smoke passed; the full product test suite was not run under the experimental compiler option.
Rust 1.99.0 was also probed without bootstrap and refused --jobs-frontend=4 unless -Z unstable-options was supplied. No repository compiler flags or toolchain were changed.
